Service · Accounting Assistance

Close the books, not your weekends.

Skilled accounting assistants who keep your ledgers clean and your month-end calm — working directly in your systems, under your finance team’s review.

Get StartedWhat’s included

Overview

What accounting assistance covers — and who it’s for.

DefinitionAccounting assistance is outsourced support for day-to-day finance operations — bookkeeping, payables, receivables, payroll processing, reconciliations and reporting — performed under the review of your finance team or accountant.

Finance teams at growing companies carry a quiet, compounding load. Transactions multiply, invoices pile up, reconciliations slip a week, and month-end turns into a sprint that eats the first days of every month. Hiring locally is slow and expensive, and it still leaves you exposed during busy season.

Akrostech accounting assistants work inside your QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Sage, follow your chart of accounts and hand over work for review on a schedule you set. You get clean, reconciled books and on-time reporting, while your controller or CPA keeps full oversight and final sign-off.

It’s built for CFOs and finance managers who need capacity without headcount, accounting firms facing tax-season peaks, and operators who want reliable numbers to run the business on.

Akrostech provides accounting support services. Final review, sign-off, filings and financial or tax advice remain with your licensed accountant or CPA.

FAQ

Accounting Assistance, answered.

The questions decision-makers ask us before they sign. Something missing? Ask us directly.

Do you work in QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite?

Yes. Our assistants work directly in QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, Sage, MYOB and Zoho Books, plus tools like Dext, Hubdoc and Gusto.

Who signs off the accounts?

Your finance team or licensed accountant does. We prepare and support; final review, sign-off, filings and advisory remain with your qualified professionals.

How is our financial data protected?

Work happens inside your systems under NDA, with role-based access, secure devices and multi-factor authentication. Access is limited to what each task requires.

Which accounting standards does your team know?

Our assistants are trained in US GAAP and IFRS conventions and follow the specific policies and chart of accounts you set.

Can you support an accounting firm during tax season?

Yes. Firms use us to add preparers and bookkeepers for peak months, then scale back once the season ends.
